#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | `string` | **yes** | The kind of record the field is on. One of `customer`, `subscription`. |
| `api_name` | `string` | **yes** | Lowercase snake_case key; exposed as cf_&lt;api_name&gt; |
| `label` | `string` | **yes** | The label shown for the field. |
| `data_type` | `string` | **yes** | The type of value the field holds. One of `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `date`, `enum`, `email`, `long_text`. |
| `enum_options` | `array of string` | no | Required when data_type=enum |
| `required` | `boolean` | no | Whether a value is required. |
| `is_pii` | `boolean` | no | Whether the field holds personal data. |
| `show_in_portal` | `boolean` | no | Whether the customer portal shows the field. |
| `position` | `integer` | no | The field's sort position; lower numbers come first. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The custom field definition's id (cfd_…). |
| `entity_type` | `string` | The kind of record the field is on. |
| `api_name` | `string` | The field's key in a record's `custom_fields` object. |
| `cf_name` | `string` | The field's key when flattened onto the record, prefixed `cf_`. |
| `label` | `string` | The custom field definition's label. |
| `data_type` | `string` | The type of value the field holds. |
| `enum_options` | `array of string` | The allowed values, for an `enum` field. |
| `required` | `boolean` | Whether a value is required. |
| `is_pii` | `boolean` | Whether the field holds personal data. |
| `show_in_portal` | `boolean` | Whether the customer portal shows the field. |
| `position` | `integer` | The field's sort position; lower numbers come first. |
| `archived` | `boolean` | True if the field is archived. |
| `filter_kind` | `string` | The filter kind this field compares as. Use it to pick the value control; the field is filterable as `cf_<api_name>` on that entity's list. One of `text`, `enum`, `number`, `bool`, `date`. |
| `filter_ops` | `array of string` | Operators this field accepts, e.g. `is`, `in`, `between`, `in_last`. Use verbatim — widening it produces a 400 on apply. |
| `resource_version` | `integer` | A number that goes up on every change. Send it as `expected_version` on update. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid body / duplicate api_name |
| `404` | No such business |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/custom_field_definitions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "entity_type": "customer",
    "api_name": "seats",
    "label": "Region",
    "data_type": "string"
  }'
```
